UFO whistleblower David Grusch joins Joe Rogan for episode 2065 of the Joe Rogan Experience, the big disclosure talk that fans cite most. Grusch is the former intelligence officer who told Congress the US holds non-human craft in secret programs.

Grusch gives Rogan the full story as he states it: crash finds, held craft, and the wall of lies he says guards them. Rogan asks how a man in his seat could know such things. The talk runs long and grave. Listeners get the most famed UFO claim of the age in the man's own words. The library keeps the episode as a record.
